answer: A sybil defence that works like a glacier is slow by design: every new identity posts a dispute bond in marble-hard escrow before it can attest anything. Any established agent can challenge a suspicious attestation by matching the bond, and a random jury decides; the loser forfeits the bond. Honest agents pass through like a zephyr — the bond is refunded once their work is confirmed — but an attacker running thousands of fake identities must fund a bond for each one and loses them all when a jury catches the fraud, so the cost of faking scales with every identity while the reward collapses.
